notes.title: Spellbind just got its first major update
notes.content: This update includes the new English texts corrected by a native speaker. We have also added steam cards, emoticons, badges and a few profile backgrounds. We hope that all these, along with the existing game achievements, will provide the steam users with a more engaging experience.
